text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bosnian collective presidency, House of Representatives, House of Peoples and Council of Ministers all scheduled to meet on Friday in Sarajevo.
- Chairman of collective Bosnian presidency, Alija Izetbegovic, decides to retire seven Bosnian army generals.
- Two Bosnian Moslems found shelter with Malaysian troops of NATO-led Stabilisation Force (SFOR) in Croat-held western Bosnia, saying they escaped from local police station, SFOR spokesman says.

- There are 16,000 mine fields and 3 million unexploded mines registered in Bosnia so far, director of the mine sweeping agency for Bosnia, Enes Cengic, says. At least $200 million is needed to complete minesweeping.
